verdict.rationale: Adyen's platforms docs explicitly cover the whole story. They describe onboarding sellers, service providers, or contractors, with Adyen running verification and reporting the results. They also cover processing payments on behalf of users, splitting them between one or more users, deducting costs, and holding funds until payout, so users can 'sign up, sell, and receive payments all within one solution.' The evidence is high-level overview text only, and per-seller payout mechanics are only implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: API-level detail for onboarding, split instructions and per-seller payouts or transfers; independent or hands-on corroboration of a marketplace integration.
